title: Crafting station and time gating are inert
reason: Crafting.can_craft compares recipe.station to a _station that ItemsApi.craft sets FROM recipe.station (api.gd:25), so the check is a tautology and never rejects. Every test site repeats the same construction so the suite cannot catch it. _time_required is never passed by any caller and time_required() has no callers. The documented gating in crafting.gd:5 is unimplemented.
next: Give the actor a set of available stations plus a crafting-speed source, pass it into Crafting instead of echoing recipe.station, and assert a wrong station fails in tests

title: data new/edit do not validate referenced ids at write time
reason: A boss loot or recipe input id is written verbatim without checking it resolves. A wave-44 agent typed a misspelt loot id, data new accepted it, and the boss file was only found wrong by the later audit. There is also no --remove-loot and no data delete, so the recovery was to delete and regenerate the file.
next: Resolve every id argument before writing and fail with the nearest matching ids; add data delete and --remove-loot so a bad reference is reversible without regenerating the resource

title: data audit does not run content findings, so percent-on-zero-baseline passes the gate
reason: tools/data.py _audit_command never calls _collect_findings. A percent modifier on a stat whose actor_stats baseline is 0.0 resolves to (0.0+0)*(1+p) = 0.0, i.e. a silent no-op, but 'data audit' reports clean. Only 'data distribution' catches it, via _resolve_zero_baseline_stats(), and distribution is non-gating by default. Found by the wave-49 J14 agent on four items.
next: Call _collect_findings from the audit path (or add the zero-baseline percent check to it) so an inert modifier fails the gate, not just the report

title: cultivation seed tasks skip existing files, so fixing a generator cannot regenerate its output
reason: tools/cultivation/seed.py and seed_systems.py both 'if path.exists(): continue'. Fixing a generator bug then has no effect: the malformed body_cultivation realms had to be deleted by hand and regenerated, and there is no --force. The same shape means a corrected generator silently disagrees with its own committed output.
next: Add --force to both seed tasks so a generator fix can be re-applied to existing resources, and fail loudly when a generator would change existing files without it

title: 30 qi sea_catalyst items are craftable but consumed by nothing
reason: QiRealmSeed declares only breakthrough_item and training_item; qi advancement and training consume those two. Nothing references qi_<realm>_sea_catalyst except its own recipe, and the name is a mind-system concept (sea of consciousness) copied into the qi/dantian namespace. So 30 items are craftable with no consumer. It surfaced as a 'consumable has N items with no modifiers' distribution warning.

title: 156 duplicate display names, many from reusing theme words across waves
reason: A corpus scan finds 156 display names shared by 2+ items across 2748 items. Some are pre-existing (C_/G_ pairs, and materials that legitimately share a name across slots such as 'Iron Ore' on nine ids), but many are this content programme's own: J1_/K1_ frost, J2_/K2_/N5_ ember, J3_/K3_ stone, J4_/K4_ cloud, M3_/N3_ cinder, M11_/N11_ kelp. Each wave picked a fresh-looking theme list without checking earlier waves, so the same theme word recurred and produced identical player-visible names.
next: Allocate theme words from a single global pool checked against all existing display names before each wave, and add a data audit check for duplicate display names scoped so it does not immediately fail on the legacy per-slot material naming
